comment_box: I am vigorously opposed to the Department of Veterans Affairs’ (VA) proposal to restrict abortion access and care for veterans and their loved ones.    Access to abortion care and counseling is essential to a person’s freedom to make decisions about their health and well-being and to have control over their economic security.   This proposed rule is an insult to all who have served and their loved ones.   VA has a mandate to provide needed care to veterans, and this includes abortion care and counseling without barriers.   For veterans, who face unique health needs or who may be survivors of military sexual assault, access to abortion is necessary to live safe and healthy lives.   Actually, this proposed rule does nothing to protect the health and lives of our veteran communities.    All veterans and their loved ones deserve access to abortion - without restrictions or political interference.   I strongly oppose this proposed rule.
